description: Na₂Fe₃SbO₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.78 Å. There are three inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-56°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.32 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-57°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.11 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-57°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.21 Å. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-56°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.06 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, two equivalent Fe, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₂Fe₂Sb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, corners with seven ONa₂Fe₂Sb trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂FeSb₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, corners with seven ONa₂FeSb₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂Sb trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Fe, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₂Fe₂Sb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, corners with three equivalent ONa₂Fe₂Sb trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramid, and edges with six ONa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and two equivalent Sb atoms to form distorted ONa₂FeSb₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, corners with three equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramid, and edges with six ONa₂Fe₂Sb trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and two equivalent Sb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and three Fe atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Fe atoms to form ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₂Fe₂Sb trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, and edges with four ONa₂Fe₂Sb trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Fe atoms to form ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₂FeSb₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, and edges with four ONa₂Fe₂Sb trigonal bipyramids.
